title: Mars habitat
note: A generated image, reconstructed at about 1.4 times real size; the model saw it at 1.7 times real size; times are real time.

facts.what: A gel cube (elastic, 10 kPa) dropped onto a heap of red regolith (the model’s sand)
facts.extra: The bread roll is simulated but drawn from the photo; the model moves it by up to 9 mm. A known limit: the soft cube stays compressed after it lands.
facts.sel: Seed 0; 2 of 8 seeds pass the selection rule, and seed 0 passes the checks between objects (worst overlap 11.0 model-mm, within one simulator grid cell) and with the photo-only objects
